code='''def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    a=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    b=next(v for v in set(sum(grid,[])) if v!=a)
    out=[[8]*w for _ in range(h)]
    top=all(grid[0][c]==b for c in range(w))
    bottom=all(grid[h-1][c]==b for c in range(w))
    left=all(grid[r][0]==b for r in range(h))
    right=all(grid[r][w-1]==b for r in range(h))
    if top and right:
        dr,dc=1,-1
        for c in range(w-1): out[0][c]=a
        for r in range(h): out[r][w-1]=a
        for r in range(h):
            c=w-1-r
            if 0<=c<w: out[r][c]=a
    elif right and bottom:
        dr,dc=-1,-1
        for r in range(h-1): out[r][w-1]=a
        for c in range(w-1): out[h-1][c]=a
        for r in range(h):
            c=r-(h-w)
            if 0<=c<w: out[r][c]=a
    elif left and bottom:
        dr,dc=-1,1
        for r in range(h-1): out[r][0]=a
        for c in range(1,w): out[h-1][c]=a
        for r in range(min(h,w)): out[r][r]=a
    else:
        dr,dc=1,1
        for c in range(1,w): out[0][c]=a
        for r in range(h-1): out[r][0]=a
        for r in range(h):
            c=h-1-r
            if 0<=c<w: out[r][c]=a
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==b:
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=b
    return out
'''
